author: rodrigorangelmendes
content: well, long story short: i've been listening a lot to d4vds music lately and got a chance to see him perform in portugal 2 nights ago. only heard about his concert 2 days before, so i hopped on my motorcycle and traveled 500km (± 310 miles) specifically to see him. on the day of his concert, i got in early and was the first person standing on the exact same stage he was going to perform on. sat there for around 6 hours until the concert began. it was totally worth the wait. best concert of my fucking life. loved every single second. at the end, i flew to the gate near backstage so i could see him get down the stairs of the stage. as soon as i saw him, me and a few guys that did the same as me started yelling for him. because of that, i got to hug him, tell him how important his music was to me, and got him to sign my arm. well, 2 days later (as soon as i could), i tattooed it. it was an experience i'll never forget, and i'll never support an artist as much as i'll ever support this guy
